title: oorexx_win_resources: one ooRexx class file that reads compiled Windows resources
summary: packages/oorexx_win_resources_v0.1 (Claude (Opus 5.5), architecture Tom Dyer) reads binary Windows resources in pure ooRexx. src/WinResources.cls is a single file with no native code, so it runs unchanged on ooRexx/WASM and on Linux. It reads .res files (rc.exe, windres, llvm-rc) and the .rsrc section of .dll and .exe files (PE32 and PE32+), and decodes DIALOG/DIALOGEX and MENU/MENUEX templates. Its WinResourceProvider is the reader ooDialog/WASM plugs in for ResDialog and BinaryMenuBar: .oodn~resourceProvider = .WinResourceProvider~new. The package is on animatedads/alchemy PR #146 (branch claude/python-gate-rc-tools-win-resources-20261114), not yet merged to main.
invariants: Pure ooRexx: no native code, no Python, no external tool at run time.
The format is detected from the content, not from the file name.
Text comes back as UTF-8 (surrogate pairs included); names compare without regard to case.
Language choice: the one asked for, then neutral, then en-US, then the first found.
Controls the contract has no kind for are listed under 'unsupported', never dropped silently.
